claims.summary: Vermeulen (2012, pp. 187–188, example 1) documents dare-ga wain-o nonda no? and the answer [Taro-ga]F wain-o nonda; the source labels Taro-ga as the answer focus in this question-answer context.

Vermeulen notes that the full-sentence answer in the example is somewhat awkward because given material is preferably unpronounced; the pair is presented as an information-structure illustration, not a required conversational script.
